claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SDM25N is a delta-opioid receptor antagonist with no reported cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; its only known antiviral activity is against dengue virus NS4B, which is irrelevant to human cancer cell lines, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
